crossRefs.note: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

translations.web: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
translations.bsb: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
